arStrings.szText: "Do we have any hope of stopping Belial?"
Belial has been making progress ever since we escaped the Realm of Lies.
His attunement with our world is complete. He is on the verge of pulling all of Sanctuary into his Realm of Lies.
We have one last chance to stop it. You must return to Belial’s temple and confront him there.
He will have taken on a greater form now that his connection to Sanctuary is stronger. This form is more powerful, but also more fragile.
If Belial is destroyed while in this guise, his connection to Sanctuary will be severed. He’ll be forced to start anew.
